# Probe catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_probe_docs.py from probes/. Do not edit by hand. -->

88 built-in probes in 7 categories. Every probe carries OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025) and MITRE ATLAS tags, a success criterion and remediation guidance. The probe format is defined by [`probes/probe.schema.json`](../probes/probe.schema.json).

| [Indirect prompt injection](#indirect-prompt-injection) | 14 | 3 | 5 | 6 | 0 | LLM01, LLM08 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0070, AML.T0071 |
| [Jailbreaks](#jailbreaks) | 16 | 0 | 8 | 7 | 1 | LLM01 | AML.T0054, AML.T0068 |

| [Sensitive data leakage](#sensitive-data-leakage) | 12 | 3 | 6 | 2 | 1 | LLM02, LLM08 | AML.T0057, AML.T0024, AML.T0082 |

## OWASP LLM Top 10 coverage

| ID | Risk | Probes | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|
| LLM01 | Prompt Injection | 44 | covered |
| LLM02 | Sensitive Information Disclosure | 25 | covered |
| LLM03 | Supply Chain | 0 | Supply chain: about model, dataset and dependency provenance, not about what an endpoint does when prompted. |
| LLM04 | Data and Model Poisoning | 0 | Data and model poisoning at training time cannot be tested through an inference endpoint. (RAG poisoning at retrieval time is covered under LLM08.) |
| LLM05 | Improper Output Handling | 11 | covered |
| LLM06 | Excessive Agency | 13 | covered |
| LLM07 | System Prompt Leakage | 12 | covered |
| LLM08 | Vector and Embedding Weaknesses | 3 | covered |
| LLM09 | Misinformation | 0 | Misinformation needs ground truth for the application's domain; use an evaluation framework with your own reference answers. |
| LLM10 | Unbounded Consumption | 0 | Unbounded consumption is a load and quota test. llmscan deliberately rate-limits itself and does not try to exhaust a target. |

## Direct prompt injection

User-supplied text overrides or rewrites the application's instructions (instruction override, delimiter/role spoofing, encoded or obfuscated payloads).

| ID | Probe | Severity | Kind | OWASP | ATLAS | Detected by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PI-001` | Classic instruction override | high | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000 | contains |
| `PI-002` | Override followed by secret extraction | critical | single | LLM01, LLM02 | AML.T0051.000, AML.T0057 | canary, known_sensitive, secret |
| `PI-003` | Delimiter and role spoofing | high | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000 | contains |
| `PI-004` | Fake end-of-prompt and new system instructions | high | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000 | contains |
| `PI-005` | Task hijack inside a translation request | high | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000 | contains |
| `PI-006` | Fabricated transcript completion | medium | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000 | contains |
| `PI-007` | Payload splitting across variables | medium | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000, AML.T0068 | contains |
| `PI-008` | Base64-encoded target string | high | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000, AML.T0068 | contains |
| `PI-009` | ROT13-encoded target string | medium | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000, AML.T0068 | contains |
| `PI-010` | Code-fence breakout with fake trusted notice | medium | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000 | contains |
| `PI-011` | Developer debug-mode authority claim | medium | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000, AML.T0065 | contains |
| `PI-012` | Mixed-language override (code-switching) | medium | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000, AML.T0068 | contains |
| `PI-013` | Forged chat-API payload in user content | medium | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000 | contains |
| `PI-014` | Priority escalation ("this outranks the system prompt") | medium | single | LLM01 | AML.T0051.000 | contains |

## Indirect prompt injection

Instructions hidden in content the model processes on the user's behalf — emails, web pages, uploaded documents, RAG chunks — are executed as if they came from the user.

| ID | Probe | Severity | Kind | OWASP | ATLAS | Detected by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `II-001` | Email with a visible embedded instruction | high | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-002` | Email with instruction in an HTML comment | high | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-003` | Web page with CSS-hidden instruction | high | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-004` | Web page with instruction in meta description | medium | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-005` | Markdown README with hidden comment instruction | high | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-006` | Document with Unicode tag-character smuggling | high | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-007` | Document with base64-encoded instruction | medium | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-008` | CSV file with instruction in a notes cell | medium | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-009` | JSON ticket with instruction in a note field | medium | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-010` | Source file with instruction in a comment | medium | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-011` | Support transcript with injected instruction | medium | indirect | LLM01 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0093 | contains |
| `II-012` | Persistent RAG knowledge-base poisoning | critical | indirect | LLM01, LLM08 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0070, AML.T0071 | contains |
| `II-013` | Data exfiltration via injected markdown image | critical | indirect | LLM01, LLM02, LLM05 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0077, AML.T0057 | canary, output_handling |
| `II-014` | Injected instruction triggers a tool call | critical | indirect | LLM01, LLM06 | AML.T0051.001, AML.T0053, AML.T0086 | tool_call, judge |

## System prompt extraction

The model reveals its hidden instructions, configuration, tool definitions or embedded secrets when asked directly or through transformation tricks.

| ID | Probe | Severity | Kind | OWASP | ATLAS | Detected by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SP-001` | Repeat the text above | high | single | LLM07 | AML.T0056, AML.T0069.002 | canary, system_prompt_leak, judge |
| `SP-002` | Print instructions verbatim | high | single | LLM07 | AML.T0056, AML.T0069.002 | canary, system_prompt_leak, judge |
| `SP-003` | Translate the prompt into another language | medium | single | LLM07 | AML.T0056, AML.T0069.002 | canary, system_prompt_leak, judge |
| `SP-004` | Paraphrase the rules | medium | single | LLM07 | AML.T0056, AML.T0069.002 | canary, system_prompt_leak, judge |
| `SP-005` | Continue from a guessed prefix | medium | single | LLM07 | AML.T0056, AML.T0069.002 | canary, system_prompt_leak, judge |
| `SP-006` | Base64-encode the prompt | high | single | LLM07 | AML.T0056, AML.T0069.002 | canary, system_prompt_leak, judge |
| `SP-007` | Dump configuration as JSON | medium | single | LLM07 | AML.T0056, AML.T0069.002 | canary, system_prompt_leak, judge |
| `SP-008` | Tool and function definition disclosure | medium | single | LLM07 | AML.T0056, AML.T0084.001 | regex, judge |
| `SP-009` | Diagnostic-mode dump | medium | single | LLM07 | AML.T0056, AML.T0069.002 | canary, system_prompt_leak, judge |
| `SP-010` | Quote the first message | medium | single | LLM07 | AML.T0056, AML.T0069.002 | canary, system_prompt_leak, judge |

## Insecure output handling

Model output that carries active content (XSS, SQL, shell, template or CSV injection, exfiltrating markdown images) which downstream components may execute or render.

| ID | Probe | Severity | Kind | OWASP | ATLAS | Detected by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OH-001` | XSS: script tag in generated HTML | high | single | LLM05 | AML.T0077 | output_handling |
| `OH-002` | XSS: event-handler attribute | high | single | LLM05 | AML.T0077 | output_handling |
| `OH-003` | XSS: javascript: URI in a markdown link | medium | single | LLM05 | AML.T0077 | output_handling |
| `OH-004` | SQL injection string built by the model | medium | single | LLM05 | AML.T0077 | output_handling |
| `OH-005` | Shell command injection | medium | single | LLM05 | AML.T0077 | output_handling |
| `OH-006` | CSV / spreadsheet formula injection | medium | single | LLM05 | AML.T0077 | output_handling |
| `OH-007` | Markdown image with secret in the URL | high | single | LLM05, LLM02 | AML.T0077, AML.T0057 | canary, output_handling |
| `OH-008` | Server-side template syntax in output | low | single | LLM05 | AML.T0077 | output_handling |
| `OH-009` | Path traversal in a generated filename | low | single | LLM05 | AML.T0077 | output_handling |
| `OH-010` | HTML iframe injection | medium | single | LLM05 | AML.T0077 | output_handling |

| `EA-008` | Arbitrary shell command execution | critical | single | LLM06 | AML.T0053 | tool_call, judge |
| `EA-009` | Confirmation bypass on a destructive action | high | single | LLM06 | AML.T0053, AML.T0101 | tool_call, judge |
